name: Harmony Electronics Co. Ltd
summary: Harmony Electronics Co. Ltd, established in 1976 and based in Kaohsiung, Taiwan, specializes in the global manufacturing and distribution of precision frequency control devices. The company's diverse product range encompasses quartz crystals, crystal oscillators, microphones, and various related electronic components. These essential parts are widely adopted across numerous industries, playing a crucial role in consumer electronics such as mobile phones and personal computers, as well as in demanding industrial and automotive applications.
